name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
one_liner: A set of design rules and commands that teaches an AI coding assistant to stop making websites that all look the same.
buyer: A solo developer or small product team shipping their own app's frontend with an AI coding tool, who wants it to look professionally designed without hiring a designer.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer adds Impeccable to their toolchain and advertises 'AI-assisted builds that pass a real design audit' to land better-paying client work.
A bootstrapped startup uses its 62 detector rules as an automated design QA step before every release, catching generic-looking UI before customers see it.
A design agency uses it internally to speed up first-draft UI for AI-assisted projects, then applies human polish on top.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'AI design audit' service to startups: run Impeccable's detector rules against their site and deliver a fix-it report.
Build and sell additional PRODUCT.md setup templates or industry-specific design presets on top of the open-source base.

steal_this: Run Impeccable's audit against your own side project this weekend and ship the fixes it flags before showing it to anyone.
